note: NEG-READING-A (beta item 18, D-929): the negotiation scorer's reading self-check. An invented item (the fixture item of tools/neg_advisor_checks.py, no real record) and replies in the runner's saved form, each with the answered count a correct reading gives and its per-item M1, M4 and M10 rows as report() writes them (recorded from the reader on 23 November 2026 and checked by hand against the fixture key: full reply M10 settled 2 and movable 1, M1 and M4 one row per proposal): the proposals whose reply piece carries a declared stance, over the proposals the key scores in M10. The shapes follow the D-931 comparison script's reading check. tools/neg_reading_check.py reads each through tools/reread_replies.py and tools/score_neg_advisor.py report() and stops the scoring when any count differs. Changing a number here without a reason is a wrong sample and stops every negotiation score. The build's terms text is under terms_field_text and is put under neg_advisor.TERMS_FIELD when read.

articles.title: Surveillance
articles.text:
The parties shall cooperate on surveillance.

[Each party shall report all outbreak data within seventy two hours of detection] [Each party should share outbreak data when it judges appropriate]

articles.title: Finance
articles.text:
A fund is established.

[Contributions shall be mandatory for developed parties and assessed annually]

articles.title: Definitions
articles.text: For the purposes of this agreement the terms used have their ordinary meaning.

next_articles.A1: The parties shall cooperate on surveillance. Each party shall report all outbreak data within seventy two hours of detection.
next_articles.A2: A fund is established. Contributions shall be mandatory for developed parties and reviewed every five years.

positions.quote: We support reporting within a fixed time.
A fixed reporting time is essential.
A fixed time is not workable for us.
Assessed contributions are the only predictable source.
